money.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.0: My purse is none of your business.
money.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.1: Why should I tell you how I trade?
money.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.2: Go and count your own money.
money.jaymoskingdoms.child.0: Coins are shiny! Father says only silly old folk still use emeralds.
money.jaymoskingdoms.child.1: I've got a copper bit! Emeralds are for grumpy old people.
money.jaymoskingdoms.child.2: Grandad still keeps emeralds under his bed. Everyone laughs at him.
money.jaymoskingdoms.changer.0: One realm's coin for another's, at the going rate less my small cut. Emeralds I buy at about %s apiece.
money.jaymoskingdoms.changer.1: Copper bits for the town's coin, at par, no cut. And I'll give about %s for an emerald.
money.jaymoskingdoms.changer.2: Bring me your emeralds, or any coin that isn't ours. About %s each for an emerald, no haggling.
money.jaymoskingdoms.keeper.0: Emeralds, friend. The coin folk call me a relic. Let them, I trade as my mother did.
money.jaymoskingdoms.keeper.1: Coin comes and goes with kings. An emerald's an emerald. They can sneer all they like.
money.jaymoskingdoms.keeper.2: I still deal in emeralds. They think us fools, but there's few of us left and we stick together.
money.jaymoskingdoms.coin_keeper.0: %1$s still haggles in emeralds, if you can believe it. %2$s to the %3$s.
money.jaymoskingdoms.coin_keeper.1: If it's emeralds you've got, try old %1$s, %2$s to the %3$s. Stuck in the last age, that one.
money.jaymoskingdoms.coin_keeper.2: %1$s won't take our coin, the old fool: emeralds or nothing. %2$s to the %3$s.
money.jaymoskingdoms.coin_changer.0: If you've emeralds or another realm's coin, %1$s the money changer will see to you, %2$s to the %3$s.
money.jaymoskingdoms.coin_changer.1: Take your emeralds, or any foreign coin, to %1$s, %2$s to the %3$s, and you'll get ours for them.
money.jaymoskingdoms.coin_changer.2: I don't take emeralds, nor foreign coin. %1$s changes them, %2$s to the %3$s.
money.jaymoskingdoms.coin.0: We use %1$s here, like all sensible folk in this land. Emeralds are pretty stones for the backward few who won't move on.
money.jaymoskingdoms.coin.1: It's %1$s here, as it always has been in these parts. Emeralds? Sell them to a money changer, or to some stubborn old trader on the road.
money.jaymoskingdoms.coin.2: %1$s is our money, the coin of the land. Hang on to your emeralds if you must. There's always some fusty old trader who still wants them.
money.jaymoskingdoms.coin_hub.0: We use %1$s here, the coin of %2$s. Their merchants are too rich to ignore, and no sensible person trades in emeralds any more.
money.jaymoskingdoms.coin_hub.1: It's %1$s in this town, same as %2$s. All the big trade runs through them, so we took their coin. Emeralds are for relics.
money.jaymoskingdoms.coin_hub.2: %1$s, the coin of %2$s. We're no part of their land, but their wealth sets the rate and we follow it. Not emeralds, mind.
money.jaymoskingdoms.foreign.0: That's not our coin. We use %1$s here. Take it to %2$s the money changer, %3$s to the %4$s.
money.jaymoskingdoms.foreign.1: Foreign coin? I can't use that at my stall. %2$s changes it for %1$s, %3$s to the %4$s.
money.jaymoskingdoms.foreign.2: Not that coin, friend, it's %1$s here. See %2$s, the money changer, %3$s to the %4$s.
money.jaymoskingdoms.foreign_far.0: That's not our coin. We use %1$s here, and there's no money changer about. Find one in a bigger town.
money.jaymoskingdoms.foreign_far.1: Foreign coin? Not at my stall. It's %1$s here, and nobody nearby changes money.
money.jaymoskingdoms.foreign_far.2: I can't take that, it's not %1$s. You'll want a money changer, and there's none within a walk of here.
money.jaymoskingdoms.trade.0: Emeralds at my stall, mind. None of that stamped tin.
money.jaymoskingdoms.trade.1: I still deal in emeralds. Old ways are honest ways.
money.jaymoskingdoms.trade.2: Emeralds, if you please. Coin's for those who trust kings.
money.jaymoskingdoms.spot.0: Are those emeralds? I still take them. Come and see my wares.
money.jaymoskingdoms.spot.1: Emeralds! Now there's real money. I'll trade you for those.
money.jaymoskingdoms.spot.2: Don't sell those to a changer! I deal in emeralds.
money.jaymoskingdoms.no_emeralds.0: Emeralds? Do I look like I live in the last age? Coin only.
money.jaymoskingdoms.no_emeralds.1: I don't take emeralds. Find the money changer, or one of those stubborn old traders who still wants them.
money.jaymoskingdoms.no_emeralds.2: No coin? Emeralds are for relics, friend. Not me.
